questions.title: Facts, goals and rules
questions.text:
The set of facts is shown below in clauses labelled 1 to 10.

```prolog
1.  direct(taraz, pavlodar).
2.  direct(almaty, kokshetau).
3.  direct(shymkent, almaty).
4.  direct(shymkent, aktau).
5.  direct(shymkent, karaganda).
6.  flies(pavlodar, fly_jet).
7.  flies(semei, kaz_air).
8.  flies(almaty, sunqar).
9.  flies(aktau, fly_jet).
10. flies(karaganda, sunqar).
```

| Clause | Description |
|---|---|
| 1 | There is a direct route from Taraz to Pavlodar. |
| 6 | Fly Jet operates flights to Pavlodar. |

questions.title: Trace table
questions.text:
The pseudocode is given below.

```pseudocode
1  ARRAY arr[7, 5, 3, 6]
2  FOR x FROM 0 TO LENGTH(arr)
3        IF x MOD 2 <> 0
4             THEN arr[x] ← x + arr[x]
5                   ELSE arr[x] ← arr[x] - x
6        ENDIF

8  ENDFOR
9  PRINT “END”
```
